comments.text: If you're looking for something unusual, try “A Labyrinth for Loons” by Michael A. Greco. Set during Malaysia's COVID lockdown, it's a dark comedy about an American writer whose increasingly absurd problems include government bureaucracy, cultural misunderstandings, and a dead body that refuses to stay comfortably dead. Funny, creepy, and unexpectedly philosophical. .. And, yes, there’s a Minotaur. On Amazon.
